mechanics.title: Configuration
mechanics.description: Edit config/debugify.json, or use the GUI (needs YACL and Mod Menu). Includes an option to default newly added fixes to off. One fix (MC-237493) can reduce or disable telemetry.

qol: Bug fixes apply automatically; no player action needed.
editor_notes: The full list of fixed bugs is not in the facts.
name: Debugify
summary: Fixes over 70 vanilla bugs from the Mojang bug tracker, on both client and server, and nothing else. Individual fixes can be toggled in a config.
